name: link-cards
description: Picker grid: two-up image cards, each with an icon, title, description and an explore link, under a centred heading. Live: #ap-gov-picker on the industry hubs.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

head_width.description: Width cap of the heading in px (hub26: Figma frames use 560 or 640). 0 keeps the variant default.

items.description: Cards. Each: title (required), body, link_label, url, image, image_top (% offset of the photo), icon (URL) or icon_svg.

stack.description: Width at which the layout stacks: 1024px (the hubs) or 900px (the Education hub).

variant.description: eduhub: the Education hub's picker (live #ap-eduhub-picker, ported whole): two tall photo cards that stack at 900px. hub26: the 2026-10 hub frames (E&U 7240:92855 and siblings): photo cards at full strength under a white fade, 32px gaps, 80px padding.
